searchLog: Read profile.md, target-companies.json (29 companies), sent-log.json (last ~40 opportunity titles, to avoid repeats), applications.json, and life/PIPELINE.md (in-flight: Claude Corps, Ford FCG, Red Ventures, TikTok, Goldman Sachs, CIL, MIT Future Fest, MLH, Horizon, 3x Adobe reqs — all excluded from consideration). Ran WebSearch (OpenAI FDE hiring) successfully, but the WebFetch tool was completely non-functional this run: every fetch attempt returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, including on api.ashbyhq.com, jobs.ashbyhq.com, openai.com, www.anthropic.com, www.notion.com, stripe.com, www.metacareers.com, www.nvidia.com, en.wikipedia.org, and even https://example.com as a control. This is a total environment-level block on the fetch capability, not a per-site policy. hunt.md's verification rule requires confirming eligibility/deadline from the actual page before including anything -- a search snippet is explicitly disallowed as sole evidence. With no working fetch, no candidate could be verified, so nothing is included. Zero verified opportunities is the honest and correct output here, not a sign nothing was findable -- promising leads existed (e.g. OpenAI FDE headcount reportedly growing fast per search results) but could not be confirmed as open, eligible, and current from source.
